headline: THREE SHOWINGS ON A SATURDAY AND NOT ONE FORM FILED YET — Ridge Trail took two tours six hours apart (its first traffic since the cut, and today's notices finally print $550,000 independently) and Comanche took a third, where the agent phoned from inside the house.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 TWO SEPARATE AGENTS WALKED THIS HOUSE TODAY, SIX HOURS APART — Patti H. of Smartway Real Estate at 11:10 AM and Drew T. of Keller Williams Vestavia at 4:00 PM, taking the all-time counter from 41 to 42 in a single Saturday. Both are first-time visits by those agents. ⭐ THIS IS THE FIRST LIVE TRAFFIC SINCE THE SELLER CUT THE PRICE ON 8/13, and it arrived inside forty-eight hours of the cut going live on a house whose last recorded read called it TOO HIGH. That is the market answering the pricing question directly rather than through a form. ✅ IT ALSO CLOSES A SOURCING PROBLEM THIS BOARD HAS CARRIED FOR TWO DAYS: both of today's notices print the list price at $550,000. Every earlier notice on file printed $559,000 because they all predate the cut, so the new number was one source seen repeatedly. It is now independently confirmed and quotable.
hotSignals.action: Call BOTH agents tomorrow morning — two same-day reads on a house whose staging score has been the open question are worth more together than either alone. Ask specifically about presentation and the electrical, not about price: the 8/4 read scored staging 2 of 5 and the 7/23 read said dirty plus glitching electrical, and nobody has been back inside since to say whether that is still true.

hotSignals.signal: 📞 AMY G. OF ETHOS INTERNATIONAL SHOWED IT AT 1:00 THIS AFTERNOON AND CALLED FROM INSIDE THE HOUSE, with her buyer standing there — two questions: does the four-car side garage convey, and why will the basement lights not turn on. That is a buyer engaging with the property rather than touring it. ✅ YOU ANSWERED THE GARAGE HALF YOURSELF BY TEXT BETWEEN 4:16 AND 4:20, and the stale task still chasing you for it has been corrected. ⚠️ DELIBERATELY NOT CALLED AN INCOMING OFFER — no offer language was used by anyone, and this board does not promote a live question into a signal it did not earn. ⭐ It is the seventeenth showing all-time, which keeps this the highest-traffic active in the book.
hotSignals.action: Two things, and the second is the one that costs money: get someone to the basement lights, because a buyer's agent standing in a dark basement is a defect story that writes itself — and follow up with her tomorrow for her buyer's read. Her question was specific and physical, which is the profile of a buyer thinking about living there.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 Amber G. of Keller Williams Hoover filed the first validating read in this listing's life off her 8/10 1:40 PM tour: interested — YES · priced right — JUST RIGHT · staging 5 of 5, the highest score this listing has ever recorded. It is the first read filed since the $4,000 cut went live on 8/5, and the price objection that had appeared on every prior read is simply gone.
hotSignals.action: ⚠️ AGENT OUTREACH IS HELD, NOT FORGOTTEN — this board is wired to email an interested buyer's agent automatically, and your own 8/7 rule puts co-op agents in the no-email lane. The desk is holding to your rule; the standing question of whether it may DRAFT one for you is on the build board, unruled since 8/8 and now seven days old. ⭐ Meanwhile Amber's read is the proof point for the two overdue calls: Cassie C. and Angela B. both called the OLD $299,000 ask too high and neither has ever been told it came down. Call, don't email.

hotSignals.signal: Wanda W. of Millennium Homes answered the interest question on her 8/8 12:50 PM showing with the single word "Very" — and left every other field on the form blank. The enthusiasm is on the record and the reason is not, which is exactly what makes it a phone call rather than a form reminder.
hotSignals.action: Call her — now seven days unworked. Ask what her buyer liked and whether size is a problem, because the other two reads that same Saturday both said the house is too small.

upcoming: ✅ RAN TODAY — Sat 8/15 4:00–4:45 PM — 2368 RIDGE TRAIL, Birmingham. Drew T., Keller Williams Realty Vestavia. Second showing of the day on this house and the 42nd all-time. No feedback filed yet.

✅ RAN TODAY — Sat 8/15 1:00–1:25 PM — 355 COMANCHE STREET, Montevallo. Amy G., Ethos International. 📞 She phoned from inside the house mid-showing: garage conveyance (answered by your text at 4:16 PM) and basement lights that would not turn on (STILL OPEN). No feedback form filed yet.
✅ RAN TODAY — Sat 8/15 11:10–11:25 AM — 2368 RIDGE TRAIL, Birmingham. Patti H., Smartway Real Estate. First of the two Saturday tours. No feedback filed yet.

📅 5167 LAKE CREST CIRCLE — closing THURSDAY 8/20 at 3:00 PM at the closing attorney's office. Five days out and the nearest closing on the board. Appraisal complete and clean, repair addendum fully executed, septic ran 8/4, and the closing invite matches stored state. ⚠️ The honest worry is silence rather than a problem — nothing has come in on this file this week, which on the biggest number closing this month earns one confirmation call to the attorney.

📅 195 LAKE VIEW CIRCLE — close receipted 8/28. Both gates cleared: inspection 8/5 at noon, appraisal 8/7 at 9:00 AM, both on primary notices. ⚠️ The appraised value itself still has not come back — DAY NINE. ⚠️ And the seller has now been waiting four days on a returned call.

📅 1709 FIELDSTONE CIRCLE — closing resolved at 10/23 off your own seller brief. ✅ The repair request LANDED and the response to the sellers is written and sitting in drafts. Two yeses and a hold on the roof pending your own licensed roofer's report.
📅 3350 ALTAMONT ROAD E21 — closing 9/14. Inspection held 8/13 at 10:00 AM; MLS reads CONTINGENT; contract-to-close packet received by the closing attorney.

⚠️ AND THAT IS THE ENTIRE CONFIRMED CALENDAR — after today's three tours, scheduled buyer traffic across the whole portfolio from here forward is ZERO. That is the quiet number on this page. It is also why the three unfiled feedback forms from TODAY are the highest-value follow-ups on the board: they are the only fresh reads in existence and nobody new is booked to walk anything.

A buyer phoned directly at 9:33 AM asking for photos of the workshop and garage. 🆕 Your own note this morning put a last name to him and escalated what he wants — this is now a SHOWING request, not a photo request. ⏰ Roughly fifty-four hours unreturned, zero outbound on any channel this desk can read.

listings.note: ✅ THE DOCUMENT THIS BOARD SAID WAS MISSING FOR TWO DAYS HAS LANDED and the seller response is written and sitting in drafts, roughly seven hours old. ⭐ THE SHAPE OF THE ASK IS GOOD NEWS: seventy-one items inspected, sixty-eight flagged at some level, and then exactly THREE asked for. That is a reasonable buyer. ⭐ THE RECOMMENDATION IS TWO YESES AND A HOLD — agree to the basement leak and a scoped HVAC service; on the roof, don't say no, say give us a few days and our own licensed roofer's report. The inspector wrote in that same section that he cannot determine the roof's age or remaining life. ⚠️ This is FHA, so the appraiser can raise the roof independently, and the remaining concession room under the FHA cap is small — plan on this being solved with work, not a check. ⭐ Contract at $390,000 against a $380,000 list, inside three weeks, after a 7/17 note warning the sellers the top of the band "may extend sales time." It did not. 🔴 The live item is the DRAFT — written, unsent, and the sellers cannot act on a document sitting in a folder.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — both gates cleared, close 8/28, and the seller is waiting on a call

Ordered is not received-by-title, and forgotten is not ordered. ⚠️ The appraised value still has not come back at DAY NINE — a quiet appraisal is usually just a quiet appraisal, but nine days earns a call to the lender. ⚠️ A co-op commission ask from the buyer's agent has never been answered.

⏰ FIVE DAYS OUT AND THE NEAREST CLOSING ON THE BOARD. ✅ Appraisal complete and clean on the lender's own words; repair addendum fully executed; septic inspection ran 8/4; closing invite matches stored state on the engine's own check. ⚠️ THE HONEST WORRY IS THE SILENCE, NOT A PROBLEM — this desk called it the quietest high-risk file in the book earlier this week and nothing has come in since. On the largest number closing this month, five days out with no traffic earns one confirmation call to the attorney rather than an assumption. ⛔ The old 8/14 close date is retired — do not re-print it.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — the plat turned up today, and the builder question is answerable
listings.note: ✅ THE DELIVERABLE WAS LOCATED THIS MORNING — the 19-lot plat, exactly what the open buyer chip has been waiting on since he answered "Yes" yesterday. That call becomes a delivery rather than a holding reply. 🔴 THE PERC QUESTION IS STILL THE GATE, and it is priced rather than blocked: the county takes record searches in person only, weekdays 8:00–3:30, at a per-record fee — across nineteen lots, a four-figure errand. ⭐ THREE-WAY CHOICE, NOT TWO: all nineteen, narrow the pull to the lots a buyer is actually asking about, or try the free path first and ask the developer, who almost certainly already holds the perc results from platting. 🔥 SIX NAMES OFF THIS AD while every other ad in the portfolio produced zero. ⚠️ Two builder outreach addresses hard-bounced permanently — they need replacing, not resending.

oweFeedback.when: 🔴 THREE ASKS AND TWENTY-FIVE DAYS OF SILENCE — 7/21, 7/22 and 7/23, from the RealtySouth Inverness listing side after your 7/21 1:00 PM tour. ⭐ THIS IS THE ONE THAT COSTS SOMETHING REAL, and the cost is not the courtesy — it is that the honest written answer IS your counter on the largest number on your board, roughly $36K of GCI. The listing side has asked repeatedly to be moved forward; a seller who reverse-offers a buyer is a seller who wants a deal. Twenty minutes of writing moves it. ⚠️ The appraisal figure your buyer cited as far under ask is single-sourced from him — do not quote it to the other side as an appraised value.

⏰ TWO FEEDBACK REQUESTS, 7/31 and 8/1, from the Keller Williams Hoover listing side. The listing has since gone from CONTINGENT to EXPIRED between the two notices, so the ask is stale — but a one-line courtesy reply costs nothing and this is a Lake Crest-subdivision agent you will meet again.
